unresolved: Cross-line averaging-window mismatch: T_sum retains a DT overshoot by subtracting only T_INTV_mean at line 224, but all associated sums are reset to ZERO at lines 225-242. Unless every threshold hit is exact, the next denominator includes residual time for which no numerator contribution remains (lines 144-145,224-242).

UUsum/UVsum/VVsum use U_davg_mean and V_davg_mean at lines 161-163 and 274-276 before the new completed-window means are assigned at lines 170-171; the ELSE path never updates those means. Thus fluctuations are referenced to a previously stored mean (and possibly uninitialized state for the first window), not the current running-window mean (lines 157-176,270-276).

The radiation-stress and depth-integrated-flux stencils iterate I=Ibeg..Iend and J=Jbeg..Jend at lines 184-185 while accessing I-1/I+1 and J-1/J+1 through lines 186-212. This is in bounds only if the GLOBAL ranges exclude physical array edges or provide ghost cells; neither invariant is established in this file.

Num_Zero_Up, HavgSum, and HrmsSum reset statements are commented out at lines 253-255, while other interval accumulators are reset at lines 225-242. Consequently the wave-height statistics published at lines 250-251 are cumulative across preview intervals rather than scoped to T_INTV_mean; the intended scope is unresolved.
